title: Merge Intervals
story: Meeting rooms: merge overlapping time ranges.
goal: Write merge_intervals(pairs): pairs is a list of [start, end]. Return the merged list sorted by start. Touching ranges (end equals next start) merge too.
hints: Sort by start. Then compare each range with the last merged one.
If start <= last end, extend the last end with max(last end, end).
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Merge Intervals”?
